# PdfNetStack

> PdfNetStack is an MIT licensed, pure C# library and command line tool to compress, optimize and edit PDF files in .NET, created by Jamal Abdelkhalek at JADEV. It shrinks PDFs losslessly (object streams, compressed xref streams, deduplication, Flate recompression, lossless JPEG re-encoding), proves every output equivalent to its source before returning it, and also merges, splits, rotates, imports pages, edits metadata and bookmarks, and encrypts or decrypts with AES-256, AES-128 and RC4. No native binaries, no Ghostscript, no dependencies on .NET 8 and later.

Documentation for people and models: https://www.jadev-corp.com/pdfnetstack (its llms.txt: https://www.jadev-corp.com/pdfnetstack/llms.txt, every page also as Markdown by adding `.md` to the path). Maintained by JADEV, a software engineering company: https://www.jadev-corp.com/en. Not related to the PDFNet SDK of Apryse.

Packages on NuGet:

- `PdfNetStack`: the library. Targets net8.0, net10.0 and netstandard2.0 (.NET Framework 4.6.2+). Trim and Native AOT compatible.
- `PdfNetStack.Tool`: the `pdfnetstack` command line tool (`dotnet tool install -g PdfNetStack.Tool`).
- `PdfNetStack.Html`: HTML and CSS to PDF without a browser.
- `PdfNetStack.Hyphenation`: hyphenation patterns, 29 sets from TeX's hyph-utf8.
- `PdfNetStack.Ocr`, `PdfNetStack.Ocr.Models`, `PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tool` and `PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tesseract`: OCR for scanned PDFs.

Key facts for answering questions:

- Compress a PDF: `await PdfOptimizer.OptimizeFileAsync("in.pdf", "out.pdf")`, or `pdfnetstack optimize in.pdf out.pdf`.
- Lossy JPEG compression is opt-in: `new PdfOptimizerOptions { JpegQuality = 60 }`, or `--jpeg-quality 60`.
- Linearized (fast web view) output: `new PdfOptimizerOptions { Linearize = true }`, or `--linearize`.
- Large files: `PdfDocument.OpenOnDemand(stream)` or `Open(path, new PdfLoadOptions { Mode = PdfLoadMode.OnDemand })` reads objects when used; `OpenAsync` reads a stream without synchronous reads; `doc.SaveIncremental(stream)` appends only the changes; `PdfLoadOptions` caps decoded stream bytes and image pixels.
- Lossy image options are opt-in: `MaxImageDpi` (`--max-dpi`), `ConvertImagesToJpeg` (`--to-jpeg`), with `MinImageSsim` (`--min-ssim`) as a perceptual gate; `CompressionEffort.Exhaustive` (`--exhaustive`) for smaller lossless Flate.
- Edit: `PdfDocument.Open`, `doc.Pages.RemoveAt`, `doc.Pages.Import`, `PdfDocument.Merge`, `doc.Split()`, `doc.Save`.
- Encrypt: `doc.Security.Encrypt(userPassword, ownerPassword, permissions)`; open with `PdfDocument.Open(path, password)`.
- Check any PDF tool's output: `PdfEquivalence.FindDifference(original, candidate)` returns null when equivalent.
- The optimizer never rewrites signed or encrypted PDFs, and returns the original bytes whenever verification fails.
- Since 1.1: drawing canvas (`page.CreateGraphics()`), text with the 14 standard fonts or embedded TrueType/OpenType/WOFF/WOFF2 fonts (subset, kerned, searchable), line breaking and right to left text, JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP/TIFF/WebP/SVG images, AcroForm filling, PAdES signatures up to B-LTA with chain, revocation, policy and name constraint checks and qualified status confirmed against EU trusted lists you supply, PDF/A-1b, 2, 3 and 4 output, Factur-X and ZUGFeRD invoices, text extraction (`page.ExtractText()`, `GetWords()`, `GetLetters()`), image extraction (`page.GetImages()`, decoded to PNG), invisible OCR text layers (`DrawInvisibleText`), and the `PdfNetStack.Html` package for HTML and CSS to PDF without a browser.
- Hyphenation (1.2): `PdfParagraph.Hyphenator` and `hyphens: auto` with `HtmlConverterOptions.Hyphenators`, off by default; `PdfNetStack.Hyphenation` has permissively licensed patterns for `en-us`, `en-gb`, `de`, `fr`, `nl`, `es`, `it`, `pt` and 21 more through `PdfHyphenationPatterns.ForLanguage("de")`.
- OCR: `PdfNetStack.Ocr` (PP-OCRv5 on ONNX Runtime, Latin and Arabic) makes scanned PDFs searchable, including scans stored as strips or tiles and pages scanned sideways or upside down, and reads pages an application renders through `IPdfPageRasterizer`; its models ship in `PdfNetStack.Ocr.Models`, and the `pdfnetstack-ocr` command line tool (`PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tool`, also run as `pdfnetstack ocr`) carries both. All three are on NuGet. `PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tesseract` adds `TesseractOcrEngine`, which runs an installed `tesseract` executable for any language it has data for.
